TextBlock.Text: Defend Nimitz against two strike pairs approaching from the east and northeast.
Two Su-24M pairs approach from the east and northeast, supported by MiG-23MLD fighters and Tu-142 reconnaissance.
Nimitz operates with Yorktown, Mahan, an E-2C and WIDOW 1: two YF-23 fighters. Four more fighters are aboard Nimitz; the first reserve pair is queued for ready-up.
Launch reserves through Flight Deck to cover the second approach. Keep Hawkeye behind the fighter screen. Use the escorts for close defense and watch fighter fuel and ammunition.

After at least 30 minutes, all four Su-24Ms must be destroyed or reach EGRESS. Win with Nimitz afloat and incoming weapons clear. Carrier or neutral loss fails the mission. Preserve the original patrol, Hawkeye and escorts for bonuses. Landing is not required for victory.

Your assigned aircraft start airborne with finite fuel and loaded weapons. Fighter sections start line abreast, one nautical mile apart; strike pairs use Vic. Give orders to the leader to control the section. Detach a wingman before assigning a separate task.

September 2025. A fictional Russian expeditionary force threatens shipping in the Gulf of Aden. The four missions are standalone scenarios. Older ships and aircraft remain in service in this alternate history. Requires only Sea Power and this mod.
